option_relations.rationale: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion is a broader category that includes Chronic Eosinophilic Leukemia, FIP1L1-PDGFRA positive.
Idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome is a diagnosis of exclusion when no underlying cause for eosinophilia is found, whereas the leaf specifies a genetic fusion.

FIP1L1-PDGFRA–positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia (CEL) is the specific diagnosis represented by the leaf. The associated generalized eruptive histiocytosis (GEH) is a manifestation of this condition.
Chronic eosinophilic leukemia is a broader category, and the leaf specifies the FIP1L1-PDGFRA positive subtype.
